scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:native && npm --prefix app run dev --
scripts.dev:debug: npm run build:native && npm --prefix app run dev:debug --
scripts.test: npm --prefix app run test && node app/test/protocol-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm --prefix app run test:e2e
scripts.test:codeclaw: cd app && npm exec tsx test/codeclaw.test.ts
